mappings.title: Device not authorized
mappings.explanation: The device is connected, but you have not approved the USB debugging dialog on the device yet.
mappings.solution: Check the device screen and press "Allow USB debugging". If the dialog does not appear, unplug the USB cable and plug it back in, or enable "Revoke USB debugging authorizations" in Developer options.

mappings.title: No USB access permission
mappings.explanation: Windows refused to let adb or fastboot access the USB device.
mappings.solution: Run DuckFlash as Administrator, then install the Google USB driver with the "Install USB Driver" button.

mappings.title: Waiting for device
mappings.explanation: The command ran but no device was detected yet.
mappings.solution: Plug the device in with a USB cable and make sure USB debugging is turned on in Developer options.

mappings.title: No device found in fastboot mode
mappings.explanation: No device was detected in fastboot mode.
mappings.solution: Reboot the device into the bootloader (Volume Down + Power), then plug the USB cable back in.

mappings.title: Device not found
mappings.explanation: No device was detected by adb.
mappings.solution: Plug the device in and make sure USB debugging is on. If Windows sees the device but adb does not, install the Google USB driver.

mappings.title: Device offline
mappings.explanation: The device was detected but the connection dropped.
mappings.solution: Unplug and replug the USB cable, or restart the adb server.

mappings.title: Bootloader is locked
mappings.explanation: The device bootloader is still locked, so partitions cannot be written.
mappings.solution: Unlock the bootloader first. Warning: the unlock process erases all data on the device.

mappings.title: Unknown partition
mappings.explanation: The selected partition does not exist on this device.
mappings.solution: Pick a partition from the available list: recovery, boot, vendor_boot, init_boot, vbmeta, or dtbo.

mappings.title: File not found
mappings.explanation: The file that was pointed at does not exist in that location.
mappings.solution: Select the file to flash again.

mappings.title: Sideload failed
mappings.explanation: The zip file that was sent could not be installed by the device.
mappings.solution: Make sure the zip is an update package made with a recovery tool, not an ordinary zip. Make sure the device is in recovery mode.

mappings.title: Device rejected the command
mappings.explanation: The device rejected the command that was sent, usually because the partition is locked or the bootloader is still locked.
mappings.solution: Make sure the bootloader is unlocked and the selected partition is correct. See the raw message below.
